FundCrown / Realty

FundCrown Realty

Income-producing real estate across U.S. markets, anchored in cash flow, capital preservation, and institutional-grade operational control through the full asset lifecycle.

Investment Thesis

Real Assets.
Durable Income.

FundCrown Realty focuses on opportunities where property fundamentals support long-term cash generation and measurable value creation, supported by rigorous underwriting and data-driven market analysis.

"We acquire assets that can survive a downturn before we plan for their upside. Every investment begins with the exit in mind."

Execution Framework

Full Lifecycle
Operational Control

FundCrown maintains direct control over every phase of the investment, from acquisition through exit, eliminating the accountability gaps created by third-party reliance.

01

Acquisition & Underwriting

Entry Discipline

Every acquisition is stress-tested across multiple rate and occupancy scenarios using CoStar and HouseCanary market data. We acquire at prices that protect the downside before targeting upside, capital preservation is the first filter, not an afterthought.

02

Repositioning & Value-Add

Operational Control

FundCrown executes repositioning strategies under direct operational control, managing renovation timelines, leasing velocity, and cost structures without reliance on third-party operators who dilute accountability and compress margins.

03

Stabilized Asset Management

Portfolio Oversight

Stabilized assets are managed through AppFolio's institutional platform, providing real-time performance tracking, automated investor reporting, and centralized lease administration, reducing operational risk across the portfolio at every stage.

04

Structured Exit Execution

Predefined Paths

Exit strategies are defined at acquisition, not improvised at maturity. FundCrown maintains multiple exit optionality paths including disposition, recapitalization, and refinancing, selected based on prevailing market conditions at the time of execution.

Asset Classes

Where We Deploy Capital

FundCrown Realty targets asset classes where operational expertise, market data, and disciplined underwriting create durable advantages over passive or generalist competitors.

Multifamily Residential

Value-add and stabilized multifamily assets in supply-constrained U.S. markets. Focus on workforce housing where demand fundamentals are supported by demographic tailwinds rather than speculative rent growth assumptions.

Mixed-Use Commercial

Neighborhood-scale mixed-use properties where foot traffic data (Placer.ai) and anchor tenant analysis support durable income projections. Preference for infill locations with limited new supply competition.

Opportunistic Repositioning

Distressed or underperforming assets in recovering submarkets where CoStar submarket data identifies a clear path to stabilization. Conservative basis acquisition with value creation through operational improvement rather than market timing.

FundCrown / Ventures

FundCrown Ventures

Selective exposure to technology opportunities that enhance real-world economics, governed independently, allocated conservatively, and executed with the same disciplinary rigor as our core real estate mandate.

Venture Philosophy

Technology That
Compounds Real Value.

FundCrown Ventures does not chase speculative growth. We participate in technology opportunities where the underlying business model enhances real-world economic activity, with clear paths to cash flow, not just valuation.

"We back technology we understand from operating it, not from reading about it. Sector expertise is our primary filter before any financial metric."

Investment Criteria

What We Back.
What We Avoid.

Real-World Anchoring

What We Back

Technology that enhances physical or financial operations, PropTech, FinTech infrastructure, applied AI in sectors we understand operationally, and software that generates measurable cost or revenue impact for established businesses.

Proven Unit Economics

What We Back

Companies with demonstrated unit economics, identifiable paths to profitability, and management teams with operational, not just technical, track records. We assess cash flow potential before valuation potential.

Pure Speculation

What We Avoid

Consumer social platforms, purely speculative crypto infrastructure, pre-revenue science projects, and any opportunity where the investment thesis depends on multiple uncertain assumptions compounding simultaneously.

Sector Unfamiliarity

What We Avoid

Technology in sectors where FundCrown has no operational expertise or advisory access. We do not compensate for unfamiliarity with financial analysis alone, sector knowledge is a prerequisite, not a preference.

Structural Independence

Governed Separately.
Protected from Realty Risk.

FundCrown Ventures operates under a governance structure formally independent from Realty operations. This structural separation ensures that the inherent risk profile of early-stage investing does not contaminate the capital preservation mandate of FundCrown Realty.

01
Independent Advisory Committee

Venture investments are reviewed by a committee with technology and sector expertise distinct from the Realty investment committee. Cross-contamination of mandate is structurally prevented.

02
Capped Allocation

Venture exposure represents a defined, structurally capped percentage of total AUM. This hard limit ensures speculative allocation cannot grow to threaten the stability of income-producing real estate holdings.

03
Separate Capital Pools

Investor capital in FundCrown Ventures is segregated at the entity level from Realty capital. Investors in either mandate have clear visibility into which pool their capital operates within at all times.

04
Milestone-Based Tranching

Capital is deployed to portfolio companies in defined tranches tied to operational milestones, not on a single-commitment basis. This reduces early-stage risk and aligns incentives between FundCrown and the companies it backs.

05
Board Participation Rights

All significant venture investments include board observation or full board seat rights, ensuring FundCrown maintains visibility into operations, hiring decisions, and capital allocation within portfolio companies.

06
Quantitative Diligence Standards

Every opportunity is assessed against standardized quantitative benchmarks before advancing to committee, market size, unit economics, runway, burn rate, and competitive positioning are required inputs, not optional context.

Governance Model

Accountability Built
Into the Structure.

FundCrown's governance model eliminates single-point-of-failure risk in capital decision-making. Structure, not personality, is the foundation of our accountability framework.

01
Investment Committee Review

All capital deployments are reviewed through a structured investment committee process. No single decision-maker can commit capital unilaterally, every deployment requires multi-party review and sign-off.

02
Independent Advisory Input

External advisors with domain expertise provide independent input on major acquisitions and ventures, ensuring objectivity in the evaluation process and reducing the risk of confirmation bias in underwriting.

03
Quantitative Stress-Testing

Every investment thesis is stress-tested quantitatively across multiple scenarios, including adverse rate environments, occupancy declines, and extended hold periods, before advancing to committee review.

04
Structured Reporting Cadence

Investors receive structured, consistent reporting through Juniper Square on a defined schedule, covering performance, distributions, portfolio status, and material developments, with no discretion on timing or frequency.

05
Segregated Capital Pools

Realty and Ventures capital pools are maintained as formally separate entities with independent accounting, auditing, and reporting, ensuring complete transparency on where each investor's capital is deployed.

06
Compliance Framework

All activities are conducted within applicable federal securities law frameworks (Reg D / Reg A+), with legal counsel, compliance review, and full documentation maintained for every investor relationship and capital event.

Growing Leadership

Built to Scale
With Discipline.

FundCrown's leadership team is expanding with purpose, each addition is evaluated for operational depth, sector expertise, and alignment with our governance standards.

Privacy
Policy

Last Updated: April 2026  |  Effective Date: April 2026  |  FundCrown LLC, United States

1. Introduction

FundCrown LLC ("FundCrown," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of individuals who interact with our website and services. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website (FundCrown.capital) or submit inquiries to us. By using this website, you consent to the practices described in this Policy.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect the following categories of information:

  • Identity and Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number, title, and organizational affiliation provided through our inquiry forms.
  • Professional and Financial Information: Investment experience, accreditation status, organizational type, and stated investment objectives, provided voluntarily to assess qualification for investment materials.
  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device identifiers, and website usage patterns collected through standard analytics tools.
  • Communication Records: Records of correspondence with FundCrown representatives, including emails and inquiry form submissions.

3. How We Use Your Information

Information collected through this website is used to: respond to investor inquiries and assess qualification status; communicate relevant investment opportunities and materials to registered contacts; maintain records as required by applicable law including federal securities regulations; conduct required identity verification and accreditation assessment; and improve our website and communication effectiveness. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process personal information on the following legal bases: (a) your consent, provided when you submit an inquiry form; (b) our legitimate interests in operating a compliant investment management business; and (c) compliance with applicable legal obligations, including securities law recordkeeping requirements.

5. Disclosure of Information

We may share your information with: legal, compliance, and financial advisors bound by professional confidentiality obligations; regulatory authorities including the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission where required by applicable law; fund administration partners including Juniper Square, operating under data processing agreements with equivalent privacy protections; and successors in the event of a business combination, merger, or acquisition of FundCrown.

6. Securities Law Notice

Nothing on this website constitutes an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security. Information collected through this website may be subject to applicable securities laws and regulations, including rules governing communications with prospective investors under Regulation D and Regulation A+ of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.

7. Data Retention

We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Investor inquiry records are generally retained for a minimum of five (5) years in accordance with financial services recordkeeping standards. Technical data is retained for up to twenty-four (24) months.

8. Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to: access your personal information; request correction of inaccurate data; request deletion of your personal information (subject to legal retention requirements); and withdraw consent where processing is consent-based. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@fundcrown.capital. Note that certain records may be retained regardless of deletion requests where required by applicable securities law.

9. Security

We implement commercially reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted to or stored by us.

10. Third-Party Links

This website may contain links to third-party websites. FundCrown is not responsible for the privacy practices of those websites and encourages you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

11. Changes to This Policy

We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Material changes will be indicated by an updated "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Your continued use of this website following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised Policy.

12. Contact

For privacy-related inquiries or to exercise your data rights, contact FundCrown LLC at:
privacy@fundcrown.capital
